text.p: French champions Monaco said on Wednesday they have signed Bosnian defender Muhamed Konjic from Swiss club FC Zurich.
They said the Bosnian international, voted best defender in Switzerland last season had signed a four-year contract, but they did not give details of the transfer fee.

A spokeswoman for the club from the pincipality did not rule out the signing of a forward, too. Croatian striker Robert Spehar of Belgium's Club Bruges has been linked with Monaco as a replacement for Brazil's Anderson, who has left for Barcelona.
Meanwhile, second division Nice announced they had signed Moroccan Mohamed Benali to strengthen their squad for the European Cup Winners' Cup.
